scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),cp=require('child_process'); if(!fs.existsSync('frontend/node_modules')){cp.execSync('npm --prefix frontend install --legacy-peer-deps',{stdio:'inherit'});}" && npm --prefix frontend run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('frontend/build')){fs.cpSync('frontend/build','build',{recursive:true}); fs.cpSync('frontend/build','dist',{recursive:true});}"
